# Metric names of windows_exporter v0.31.3, the version Alloy 1.18 embeds, for the
# eight collectors the Windows template enables. Taken from the exporter's
# docs/collector.<name>.md at that tag.
#
# keep or drop is what agents/alloy/windows/config.alloy.tmpl must do with the
# name before remote_write. tests/windows/test-windows-config.sh holds the
# template to this list, and tests/windows/test-windows-central.sh only lets the
# dashboard and the alert rules use names marked keep.
#
# When the embedded exporter changes, regenerate the names and decide each new one.
# cpu
windows_cpu_logical_processor keep
windows_cpu_cstate_seconds_total drop
windows_cpu_time_total keep
windows_cpu_interrupts_total drop
windows_cpu_dpcs_total drop
windows_cpu_clock_interrupts_total drop
windows_cpu_idle_break_events_total drop
windows_cpu_parking_status drop
windows_cpu_core_frequency_mhz drop
windows_cpu_processor_performance_total drop
windows_cpu_processor_mperf_total drop
windows_cpu_processor_rtc_total drop
windows_cpu_processor_utility_total drop
windows_cpu_processor_privileged_utility_total drop
